implementation: Private input enum shares signed community/expected-source validation, single-job admission and owned supervisor/blocking store lifetime for path/File. Both inputs now recheck runtime-owned roots after ingestion so input refusal cannot hide lost runtime ownership. SourceDirectory returns same original held File, verifies current-owner/private/regular/single-link/length/hash and stable original name/held metadata incl mutation timestamps plus directory before rewind/deadline; wrapper/current caller behavior/platform refusal retained. Nonblocking private open prevents substituted FIFO blocking. Caller retains directory/name/admission obligations after return. Tests use synthetic signed opaque bytes, not genuine export or production publication. Runtime unit separately re-signs valid wrong-source and foreign-community contexts to isolate binding refusals; busy admission and full shutdown/reopen checked. Source-directory cut-point metadata/name/root/expiry tests are deterministic, not concurrent races; same actual descriptor checked and consumed by material API.
scope: four-file trusted runtime ingestion and same verified held archive adapters; no publisher/journal/server startup wiring
